svg.title: A terminal typing out what this account is for
svg.desc: 👋🏻 Hello World! / 🏗️ Keep the right way easy / 🩺 Notice it before the pager does / 🪵 The context in one place / 🧩 Pieces that fit without glue / 🔗 No package without a review / 📮 A fix that arrives reviewed / 📦 Solving the same problem once / 🎯 Solves exactly what it claims / ⏱️ A review in under five minutes / 🪄 No implicit steps in the deploy / 💬 A commit that reads as prose / 🛠️ Fix the cause, not the ticket

g.text: 🩺 Notice it before the pager does
⏱️ A review in under five minutes
🪄 No implicit steps in the deploy
💬 A commit that reads as prose
🛠️ Fix the cause, not the ticket
